content.text: Digital creators in regions lacking robust [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-infrastructure-south-asian-creators-everything-you-need-2|COREMERCH guide to payment]]-methods-filipino-digital-creators-everything-you-need|Payment Methods]] solutions face a significant challenge: conventional platforms like Stripe and PayPal are either unavailable or severely restricted. This gap leaves many unable to operationalize their online stores effectively. Fortunately, with COREMERCH's infrastructure solutions, you can build a fully functional digital store using Supabase as your order database. This guide will equip you with the necessary steps to set up your infrastructure, ensuring you can accept [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/crypto-payment-gateways-digital-products-explained-digital-creators-10|crypto]] payments seamlessly and take control of your digital sales.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The traditional payment platforms are not just inaccessible; they often come with high fees, restrictive policies, and poor support for creators in developing regions. COREMERCH addresses these issues by providing a direct path to sovereignty in digital commerce. By using a combination of GitHub Pages, Apps Script, and NOWPayments, you eliminate reliance on third-party platforms and take ownership of your infrastructure. With Stack 01, you can get started quickly, deploying your store within 4-6 hours, making it a practical solution in regions where financial isolation is common.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before diving into deployment, gather the essential tools: a GitHub account for hosting your site, access to Google Apps Script for backend logic, and a NOWPayments account for crypto payment processing. Ensure you have digital products ready to sell, such as ebooks or courses, and prepare any necessary documentation. Familiarize yourself with the Sovereign Blueprint, as it provides detailed instructions for setting up your infrastructure. With these components in place, you are well on your way to establishing your digital store.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Begin by deploying Stack 01, which utilizes GitHub Pages for your storefront and Google Apps Script for order processing. This step involves uploading your product files and configuring the Apps Script to handle incoming orders. Once this is operational, integrate NOWPayments to facilitate crypto transactions. The integration is straightforward and allows you to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies with minimal fees. After setting up the payment layer, configure the delivery system to ensure that customers receive their products promptly upon payment confirmation, creating a seamless shopping experience.
Take control of your digital sales with sovereign infrastructure.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

With your payment and delivery pipeline set, it's time to go live. Test your store by processing a transaction using a cryptocurrency that NOWPayments supports. Monitor the transaction closely to ensure that payment confirmations and product delivery occur without any issues. This phase is crucial as it allows you to identify any potential problems before promoting your store to a wider audience. Once you confirm that everything functions as expected, you're ready to launch your store publicly.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After launching your digital store, consider strategies for scaling your operations. This may include adding more products to your inventory or integrating additional payment options via NOWPayments. Utilize analytics to track sales and customer behavior, enabling you to optimize your offerings. You can also explore the Edge Commerce Stack for a more robust setup, which allows for more extensive product management and enhanced features. Continuous improvement of your infrastructure will ensure that you remain competitive and capable of meeting customer demands.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

Building a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free is straightforward. Start by using Stack 01 from COREMERCH, which utilizes GitHub Pages and NOWPayments for quick deployment. Follow the Sovereign Blueprint for a step-by-step guide, allowing you to launch your store within hours without relying on traditional payment platforms.
Stack 01 empowers creators with rapid deployment and ownership of their store.

For more complex needs, consider the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), which enhances the capabilities of your store with additional features and support. Your Deployment Checklist

Create a GitHub account for hosting your site. Set up Google Apps Script for backend logic. Register for a NOWPayments account for processing crypto payments. Prepare digital products to sell and familiarize yourself with the Sovereign Blueprint. Deploy Stack 01 following the detailed instructions. Configure your payment and delivery systems. Test the infrastructure with a live transaction. Monitor the transaction closely to ensure smooth operation. Launch your store and promote it to your audience.

What is the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 in COREMERCH?

Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?

Yes, you can host a digital product store on both GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages. GitHub Pages is ideal for Stack 01 deployments, while Cloudflare Pages is used in Stack 02 for enhanced performance and scalability.
What types of products can I sell using COREMERCH's infrastructure?
With COREMERCH's infrastructure, you can sell a variety of digital products, including ebooks, online courses, templates, software, and other digital goods, allowing you to reach a global audience.
How do I ensure my customers receive their products after payment?

Ensure your payment and delivery systems are correctly configured. With NOWPayments integrated, products are automatically delivered upon payment confirmation, creating a seamless experience for your customers.
